clips.text: Silence is benediction but not the silence you can create, because you are the noise so you cannot create silence.
But you can create the illusion of it, and this illusion is created by all sorts of auto-hypnotic techniques.
So never use auto-suggestions to be silent; rather, be aware of the constantly chattering mind, and be aware, not to make it still but to understand it.
This very understanding flowers into a silence which is not just absence of noise but a positive bliss.
